fields.body:
# Alphabet (GOOG) — 10-Year Thesis Ledger
> v1.0 · 2026-08-22 · Approved by: Director · status: active

## 10-Year Thesis
A company that, while defending the 'toll on intent' (search), is building a second and third toll: the AI full stack (TPU→Gemini→products) and real-world
agents (Waymo). We observe a franchise wrapped in capex fear refuting those fears one by one — Berkshire reached
the same conclusion before we did ($36.6B, bought in three stages).

## Core Hypotheses
1. **The search moat is undergoing metamorphosis, not erosion** [Conviction: High]
   Basis: even amid the spread of AI search, search ads +17% (2026 2Q), shopping ad relevance +20%,
   double-digit growth for 11 consecutive quarters. The "death of search" thesis has yet to show up in earnings.
   Refutation condition: search revenue growth decelerates into single digits for two consecutive quarters and the Gemini substitution
   effect shows up in ad unit prices.
2. **Cloud + TPU become the second toll** [Conviction: High]
   Basis: cloud +82%, backlog of $514B, TPU sales to external data centers begun (revenue recognition
   started), token processing of 22B/minute (+37% in one quarter), supply constraints persist.
   Refutation condition: backlog conversion slows and external TPU demand remains negligible
   relative to internal consumption.
3. **Capex is not fear but See's-grade reinvestment** [Conviction: Medium]
   Basis: 2026 guidance of $175–185B — the biggest test of the Buffett frame. Whether incremental capital
   returns as incremental tolls is the heart of this thesis.
   Refutation condition: cloud margin improvement stalls and ROIC trends downward for two years — at that point it is downgraded from the See's type
   to the FlightSafety type and the fair multiple is lowered.
4. **Waymo is a third toll candidate riding along for free** [Conviction: Medium]
   Basis: 500,000 fully autonomous rides per week (doubled within a year), 11 cities, expansion to the UK and Japan —
   entering the commercial-proof stage. Refutation condition: per-city unit economics, once disclosed, show structural
   losses, or expansion stalls for 3+ years due to regulation.

## Relationship to the Buffett Scale
Added to the Parallax zone: fair MAX 32 · current gap around +35% (watching, near the serious line).
The moment the Berkshire baseline (+40%) reopens — the next fear event (antitrust ruling, further
capex increase) — is this ledger's best observation point.

## Next Observation Points
- 3Q earnings (late October): cloud growth rate, TPU external revenue line, changes in capex guidance
- Gemini 4 release (pretraining officially mentioned as in progress)
- Ruling on the ad tech antitrust remedy proposal — the real-world form of a "verifiable fear"
